## Design

### 2026-10-02 — We defined a custom, offline physical media player built around the DFPlayer Mini MP3 module and an Arduino Nano Every. The design features physical tactile push-buttons for media navigation, a 1.3-in

**10h**

We defined a custom, offline physical media player built around the DFPlayer Mini MP3 module and an Arduino Nano Every. The design features physical tactile push-buttons for media navigation, a 1.3-inch I2C OLED display for track/status feedback, a $3.5\text{ mm}$ headphone jack for stereo output, and a dedicated lithium battery power management system.

I spent some time diving into the DFPlayer Mini datasheet to better understand its capabilities and pin configurations for audio playback projects. The document outlines everything needed to interface the module with microcontrollers like Arduino, including its pinout, supported file formats (MP3 and WAV), and communication protocols.The DFPlayer Mini features a built-in 3W amplifier and an SD card slot, allowing standalone or serial-controlled audio playback. It uses standard UART serial communicatio
